title: Executive Order No. 55, s. 2018
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 55

CONSTITUTING A STEERING COMMITTEE FOR’ THE
COMMEMORATION OF THE QUINCENTENNIAL OF THE ARRIVAL
OF FERDINAND MAGELLAN IN THE PHILIPPINES, THE VICTORY
OF LAPU-LAPU IN THE BATTLE OF MACTAN, AND OTHER
HISTORIC EVENTS THAT HAPPENED FROM 1519 TO 1522

WHEREAS, pursuant to Republic Act No. 10086 or the “Strengthening
People’s Nationalism Through Philippine History Act,” the State shall provide the
means to strengthen people's nationalism, love of country, respect for its heroes and
pride for the people's accomplishments by reinforcing the importance of Philippine
national and local history in daily life with the end view of raising social

consciousness;

WHEREAS, various entities have been proposing to the National Historical
Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) the conduct of certain activities for the
commemoration of the 500" anniversary of the arrival of Ferdinand Magellan in the
Philippines, the celebration of the first mass in the Philippines, the circumnavigation
of the globe by Ferdinand Magellan-Juan Sebastian Elcano from 1519 to 1522, the
victory of Lapu-Lapu in the Battle of Mactan, and other events associated thereto;

WHEREAS, the staging of commemorative activities in the Philippines for the
quincentennial celebration will promote tourism and highlight our rich cultural and
religious heritage as a nation;

WHEREAS, there is a need to systematically organize, coordinate and
synchronize the commemoration of the quincentennial of the arrival of Ferdinand
Magellan in the Philippines and other historic events that happened from 1519 to
1522 in different localities and in other countries where Magellan’s voyage made
landfall, by creating a committee that shall take charge of the preparations for the
said commemoration in the Philippines;

WHEREAS, Article VII, Section 17 of the 1987 Constitution provides that the
President shall have control of all the executive departments, bureaus and offices;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic
of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and
existing laws, do hereby order:

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
SECTION 1. The National Quincentennial Committee. A_ steering
committee for the commemoration of the quincentennial of the arrival of Ferdinand
Magellan in the Philippines, the victory of Lapu-Lapu in the Battle of Mactan, and
other historic events from 1519 to 1522 is hereby created, to be known as the
National Quincentennial Committee.

SECTION 2. Composition. The National Quincentennial Committee shall be
constituted as follows:

Chairperson, to be appointed by the President;

NHCP, as Vice Chairperson;

Department of Foreign Affairs;

Department of the Interior and Local Government

Department of Tourism;

Department of Budget and Management; and

Other members from the government and the private sector, as may be
designated by the President, upon recommendation of the Committee.

SECTION 3. Functions. The Committee shall take charge of the preparations
for the commemoration, and for this purpose, shall have the following functions:

(a) Undertake the overall study, conceptualization, and implementation of
programs and projects relevant to the commemoration and which makes
use of history, culture, and media for the purpose of reinvigorating the
spirit of national unity and international comity;

(b) Act as the principal coordinator for all activities related to the
quincentennial commemoration, including those intended to increase
awareness of the quincentennial among Filipinos;

(c) Serve as the clearing house for the preparation and dissemination of all
information about the plans and activities for the quincentennial of
Magellan’s arrival and its associated events;

(d) Constitute working groups which shall undertake the implementation of the
programs and projects;

(e) Prioritize the refurbishment of historical sites and structures associated
with the quincentennial;

(f) Receive donations for the purpose of achieving the objectives of this
Order, subject to applicable laws, rules and regulations; and

(g) Call upon any government agency or instrumentality, and invite private
individuals and organizations, including overseas or international entities,
to assist in the performance of its functions.

SECTION 4. Secretariat. The Committee shall be provided with technical and
administrative staff support by a Secretariat to be constituted by the NHCP.
 
SECTION 5. Funding. The Committee shall be funded with an initial budget
of Ten Million Pesos (R10,000,000.00) to be drawn from the Contingent Fund.
Appropriations for succeeding years shall be incorporated in the budget proposal of
the NHCP.

SECTION 6. Comprehensive Plan. The Committee shall prepare, for
approval of the President, a Comprehensive Plan for the Quincentennial
Commemoration within six (6) months from the effectivity of this Order.

SECTION 7. Sunset Provision. The Committee shall be an ad hoc body and
its existence shall terminate on September 2022.

SECTION 8. Separability. If any section or part of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
shall remain in full force or effect.

SECTION 9. Repeal. All executive issuances inconsistent with this Order are
hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

SECTION 10. Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 8th day of May in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Eighteen.

 

By the President:
